messages.subject: Kingsmoor - completion statement and funds for 1 May
messages.plaintextBody:
Priya,

Completion statement attached for completion on 1 May. Balance due from the Buyer on completion is £12,321,627.92 (price £14,150,000 less the £1,415,000 deposit, the £45,000 retention and the £188,500 rent deposits accounted to us, less rent and service-charge apportionments, plus a small insurance apportionment to the Seller). Separately, SDLT of £697,000 is payable to HMRC within 14 days. Please arrange the completion funds to our client account by 30 April.

Elena

Elena Marchetti
Associate | Real Estate
Whitfield Carter LLP
